title: reported_total
description: One committee's reported totals for a cycle: what it raised, spent, holds and owes, as the FEC's summary files give them, cycle to date. FEC's figures as filed: a blank is null, a filed 0 is 0, nothing is netted or corrected. Never add one to `contribution` amounts: a reported total already holds the itemized money those rows itemize. From 2008 from `committee_summary`, a Form 5 or Form 7 filer's blank figures from `webk`; 1996–2006 from `webk`, which holds no House or Senate campaign committee; none before 1996. A column a cycle's file lacks is null. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

source_file.description: The FEC summary file the figures are from: `committee_summary`, `committee_summary+webk` (a figure `committee_summary` left blank is `webk`'s) or `webk`.

period_start.description: The start of the committee's first report of the cycle; null before 2008. As FEC files it, so it can fall after `period_end` (C00807263, 2024).

period_end.description: The end of its latest report of the cycle, which says how current the figures are. As FEC files it, so it can fall before `period_start`.

cash_on_hand_start.description: Cash on hand at the start of the reporting period.

cash_on_hand_end.description: Cash on hand at its end.

debts_owed_by.description: Debts owed by the committee at the end of the reporting period.

debts_owed_to.description: Debts owed to it; null before 2008.

individual_itemized.description: Contributions from individuals itemized on its reports; null before 2008.

individual_unitemized.description: Contributions from individuals of $200 or less a year, reported as one lump and never attributed to a donor; null before 2008.

individual_total.description: Contributions from individuals, itemized and unitemized. Filers' arithmetic is kept: it need not equal the two figures added.

candidate_loan_repayments.description: Repayments of loans from the candidate.

transfers_in.description: Transfers from affiliated or authorized committees.

transfers_out.description: Transfers to affiliated or authorized committees.

party_coordinated.description: Coordinated expenditures made by a party committee.

operating_expenditures.description: Operating expenditures, from whichever of the FEC's two lines its forms fill.
